name: openbb_equity_profile
description:
Company profile for one stock through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.profile).
Returns: {symbol, provider, profile: one record (name, sector, industry, market cap, employees, description, website)} or {symbol, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; provider (fmp, intrinio, yfinance; default yfinance).
Other sources: yf_stock_info, av_company_overview; executives: openbb_equity_management. Keys: yfinance needs none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; intrinio needs a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"symbol": "MSFT"}
